entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand sensor. It's not working.
I'm very sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a technical fault. The pulse reading is completely inaccurate. Look, I **don't have time** to troubleshoot this thing, it's clearly **garbage**. I **just want my money** back. Can you process a **refund** or not?
I understand your frustration and I can certainly check on that for you. Can I get your order number, or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th.
That was 39 days ago. Let me just check our policy... Yes, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return period. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Okay, good. What do I do next?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label. Just package the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any shipping center. Once our warehouse scans it, the refund will be credited back to your original payment method within five business days.
Alright, that works. That's all I needed.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
